column3: Near-verbatim counterpart: God's enemies are gathered and held in ordered ranks for judgment.

The devils' incitement of disbelievers does not portray a gathered or marshalled group.

The letter commands submission, showing Solomon exercising authority beyond the marshalled force.
The queen convenes her council over Solomon's command, a political counterpart to ordered collective action.
Solomon summons his council to bring the throne, directly showing his ability to command varied agents.
An ifrit from the jinn offers service to Solomon, directly identifying a commanded jinn agent.
Another agent carries out Solomon's command with exceptional speed, completing the scene of ordered service.
The wind is subjected to Solomon's command, broadening the created forces directed by him.
Devils work and dive for Solomon under divine preservation, directly paralleling disciplined nonhuman service.
Jinn perform assigned works for Solomon, a direct continuation of his organized command over them.

God strengthens David's kingdom, supplying the dynastic background for Solomon's exceptional rule.
Fine steeds are presented to Solomon, connecting his rule with organized military resources.
Solomon's attention to the steeds develops the military-capacity setting of his kingdom.
Solomon's handling of the steeds remains a related image of command over military assets.
Solomon asks for an unparalleled kingdom, directly framing the distinctive authority manifested in 27:17.
The wind is made subject to Solomon and runs by his command, directly parallel to controlled forces.
Devils are subjected to Solomon as builders and divers, directly matching commanded nonhuman agents.
Other devils are bound in chains, closely echoing the focus ayah's restraint and regulation of a force.
Defeated opponents are told they will be gathered to Hell, joining military defeat to final collection.
God will gather humanity on the unquestionable Day of Resurrection, a broad eschatological counterpart.

Nations of jinn and humans enter the Fire together, a punitive counterpart to the focus ayah's mixed kinds.
Many jinn and humans are destined for Hell, linking the two kinds in a collective moral outcome.
Disbelievers' war spending ends in defeat and their gathering to Hell, combining hostile force with final assembly.
The command to prepare force and tethered horses gives a direct military-order parallel.

God gathers all creatures and leaves none behind, a comprehensive counterpart to the focus ayah's gathering.

Humans and devils are gathered around Hell, a strong punitive counterpart involving multiple kinds.
All are brought before God, expressing collective presentation under divine control.

Those gathered for judgment are directed along the path to Hell, extending controlled collective movement.
The command to halt them for questioning continues the scene of restrained, ordered judgment.
Disbelievers are driven to Hell in groups, a punitive image of controlled collective movement.
The reverent are driven to Paradise in groups, a positive counterpart to collective direction.
The Day of Gathering divides people into Paradise and the Blaze, directly naming the greater eschatological assembly.
God can gather the creatures spread through the heavens and earth, extending the focus's diverse-creature gathering.
Every community is seen kneeling and called to its record, an ordered public assembly for judgment.
The earth splits and people emerge rapidly; God calls this a gathering easy for Him.
People emerge from graves and hasten toward the caller, portraying compelled collective movement.
They rush toward the caller with fixed attention, continuing the image of directed eschatological movement.
The former and later peoples are appointed for a known Day, preparing their universal assembly.
The former and later peoples are explicitly gathered at a fixed Day, a direct final-gathering counterpart.
The first gathering of the People of the Book invokes organized displacement and collective mobilization.
God loves those who fight in ranks like a solid structure, the clearest military-order parallel to 27:17.
